Summary

A 20" flat-tube Trinitron from Sony's 2002 Wega range, built on the BA-6 chassis.

Literature

  • User Manual

Notes

No RGB input, and the one-chip BA-6 chassis has no known RGB mod. Component is the best signal it takes.

There is no S-Video jack, but one can be added.

Velocity modulation is on by default and can be switched off in the picture menu.
